## 2. Professional Biography & Summary

Junaid A S is an Indian AI Architect, AI Engineer, and Automation Specialist based in Palakkad, Kerala. He specializes in designing autonomous intelligent architectures and engineering deep automation workflows that automate complex tasks end-to-end.

Junaid works across the full product lifecycle: from AI system design, autonomous multi-agent pipelines, and UI/UX design in Figma, through mobile engineering in Flutter, backend development in Python (Django, Flask, FastAPI) and Node.js, to Dockerized cloud deployments on AWS, Firebase, and Cloudflare.

Currently, Junaid serves as an AI Architect & Engineer at Artcl.in in Palakkad, where he designs enterprise AI systems, automated intelligence workflows, enterprise RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, and machine learning microservices. Previously, he worked at Febno.co in Calicut as a Python Full-Stack Developer Intern developing Django and PostgreSQL applications.

## 3. Flagship Projects & Technical Architecture

### Project 1: SayBill AI — Voice-First Point of Sale & Retail Management Ecosystem
- **Overview**: An AI-powered voice billing and retail POS ecosystem engineered to eliminate manual input friction in high-volume retail stores.
- **Frontend Architecture**: Built with Flutter and Dart. Uses Dart Isolates (background concurrency threads) to continuously stream raw audio chunks over WebSocket connections to the speech pipeline without blocking the main UI thread (maintaining 120 FPS rendering).
- **AI / LLM Pipeline**:
  - Unstructured audio is transcribed and passed to an instruction-tuned LLM parser.
  - The model enforces strict JSON schema serialization (action, items, quantities, brand hints, discount scopes).
  - Schema payload is matched against the store inventory using fuzzy search algorithms to map generic terms ("milk") to specific stock keeping units ("Amul 1L").
  - Features an offline fallback regex and keyword parser for zero-connectivity situations.
- **Hardware & Omnichannel Integrations**: Real-time camera Vision barcode scanner, automatic PDF bill generation with direct WhatsApp messaging, and ESC/POS Bluetooth thermal printing.
- **Key Metrics**: 98.6% speech parsing accuracy, sub-420ms end-to-end voice-to-cart latency, 70% reduction in retail checkout time.
- **Project URL**: https://junaidas.in/projects/saybill

### Project 2: ERMS — Educational Resource Management System
- **Overview**: An enterprise management portal for colleges and training institutes to track student performance, manage attendance, and automate academic reporting.
- **Backend Architecture**: Developed using Python Flask and structured using SQLYOG / MySQL with compound indexing strategies and connection pooling.
- **Automated Analytics Engine**: Calculates class grade distributions, percentile ranks, and longitudinal progress tracking on the fly. Generates one-click print-ready PDF grade sheets.
- **Project URL**: https://junaidas.in/projects/erms
